# Bundled walking route data

`RoadNet.lua`, `Roads.lua`, and `Steep.lua` come from [Mapzeroth](https://github.com/tr0tsky0/Mapzeroth), commit `279fc6c9cb1a04f4ed18677814e7ccdcff9d4f6b`, copyright 2026 tr0tsky, under the MIT license in this directory. The only changes are to load them into Devitools' isolated routing context. Road and terrain records are generated from the game client; World of Warcraft game content remains Blizzard Entertainment's property.
